questions.q: Which three courses make up the Advanced stage of the Salesforce Data Analyst path?
options: Salesforce CRM Analytics & Tableau Next, Snowflake, and dbt / Analytics Engineering
questions.explain: The Advanced stage covers CRM Analytics and Tableau Next, Snowflake, and dbt / analytics engineering.

questions.q: Why are problems like blending leads, opportunities and cases and keeping history described as data-modeling problems?
options: They can only be solved in a dashboard filter
They are best solved once, upstream in the data, so every dashboard downstream is consistent
questions.explain: An analytics engineer models the data once so all reports draw from consistent, tested sources.

questions.q: How should you treat the job titles on the career ladder?
options: As a typical shape; read job descriptions for the skills because titles vary
questions.explain: Titles and pay differ between employers, so job descriptions and required skills are a better guide.

questions.q: According to the lesson, what usually counts for more than a single credential in hiring?
questions.explain: Real projects show your ability to solve problems and communicate results, so they usually carry more weight than one credential.

questions.q: What should you do while you are applying for jobs?
options: Stop learning until you are hired
Start the Advanced stage so you keep improving
questions.explain: Applying and learning can run together. Starting CRM Analytics and Tableau Next keeps your skills growing toward analytics engineering.
